Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD move; arrow keys fire/aim and set facing (movement+fire combine). Space = activate item/pedestal; Q = card. Waiting delays. Fine presses: 0.1s ≈40px, 0.2s ≈80px; 0.5s hold ≈200px. Doorway transitions usually need 2-3 presses once the sprite overlaps the door graphic; near-exact centering required. Overlap sprite may render over wall.

HUD/MECHANICS (observed): hearts (hollow when lost), coins, keys, bombs, item/card slots, minimap. Pickups on touch: floor coins, keys, pills (red pill = heal +blue heart; blue pill = +1 key), fuse-lit floor pickup (effect maybe random: gave bomb once, key once). Locked gray/red-barred chests: pressing into them repeatedly may open them; key not visibly consumed. Plain poop gave nothing this run. Rock rings resist TECH X bursts (chest inside rock ring could not be cracked). Some chests in the dark stone room appeared to MOVE and grow spiky appendages (mimic-like) — treat mobile chests cautiously. Pedestal items: stepping near/into them plus Space shows a name banner (e.g. 'TECH X — Laser ring tears') and equips the item; pedestal item confirmed equippable.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear travels ~120px ahead then bursts in an arc ~1.5 tiles wide; red X marks impact; sometimes splashes seemed wall-based (uncertain). Blind spot: targets under ~70px are missed (burst lands past them); horizontal/vertical offset must be under ~70px at burst range; ~90-130px spacing is ideal. Damages spiders, gray faces, fat enemies, gilded mounds, statue; does NOT crack rock rings or TNT barrels; poop in the dark dead-end room unaffected (burst passed between mounds, so untested directly). Space with Match Stick / Q with 'II – The High Priestess' card showed no visible effect (purpose unknown).

PLAYER SPRITE: alternates wildly (white round face, black-eyed, TV/monitor head, striped egg, yellow blob with glasses, pale/ghost blob, bald, invisible frames). Confirm identity by moving/firing. TV-head and gray-faced sprites also appear as ENEMIES — don't assume a sprite is you.

ENEMIES (observed): winged flies; knife-topped; fat pink/white-faced (tanky, enrage, chase, contact drains hearts fast, die to sustained bursts at ~120-150px); shelled white-faced from rock piles leaving damaging green cloud; blue-white spiky creatures in rocks; gray wall-faces that relocate between wall positions and rock-ring pods, spit blue/green orbs/tears, and seem to spawn endlessly (no coin rewards); small red-eyed black spiders in the dark stone room — fast chasers, cluster, killed by bursts when grouped at ~100px but deadly at close range (caused my death). Gray-face death also leaves a green damaging cloud. Pink stationary orb-emitters suspected invulnerable. Green spiky clouds persist seconds and damage. All-hollow hearts while still alive observed again after a fatal-looking hit; no game-over text appeared and control seemed to persist but movement/firing produced no visible change (uncertain whether alive).

FAILED STRATEGIES: walking into brazier rock ring or through it; bursting rock rings/chests (no effect); firing under ~70px (blind spot); fighting fast spiders at close range with low hearts; lingering in green clouds/orb lanes; pressing inert wall marks; assuming static poop yields loot; assuming a doorway works without repeated presses.

NAVIGATION (observed chain): Tutorial room (inert control diagrams on walls; top hatch, bottom hatch, right-wall dark riveted door) ↔ bottom → brazier room (four lit corner braziers, locked chest inside rock ring, shootable poison poop, golden gate bottom-center, top alcove back to tutorial) ↔ gate → item room (pedestal; Space to take item; top gold door back). Brazier room rock ring blocks straight vertical travel — go around via the left open corridor to reach the top alcove or bottom gate. Golden gate → dark two-poop dead-end chamber (gold door top only; faint inert gray floor squares, no loot) — dead end. Tutorial top → rock room (scattered rocks, left gold keyhole door → SHOP at 15¢ card / 5¢ bomb, top and bottom hatches; endless wave enemies incl. shelled, flies, gray pods). Rock room bottom hatch loops back to tutorial. Tutorial right-wall dark door → dark stone-walled room with red-barred locked chests (two on top wall, one inside a center white-spike ring), two dark floor holes (likely pits), faint heart floor mark, and black spiders. Prior run: rock room top hatch → TNT room (barrel column guarding locked chests, crates) → top hatch → boss room (fat/knife enemies, gray spawner faces, damageable left-wall statue with gold item/blood mist, gilded mound, blue spiral, decorative non-door wall marks, giant high-heel leg boss once); exits locked during fights.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES: doors/hatches usually gate on clearing enemies, but some hatches seemed sealed regardless (possible decoys); is the wall statue a boss or decor; do blue orbs/spiral/red flesh deal damage; where the golden key is; card purpose; meaning of all-hollow hearts (possible revive/extra-life state); do dark-room floor holes kill on entry; are red-barred chests mimics or normal; how to reach the rock-ring chest (bombs suspected, shop 5¢ with 0 coins earned so far).
